title: coelogyne stricta
intro: Coelogyne stricta, commonly known as the Himalayan Coelogyne, is a type of orchid native to the Himalayan region. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, and its health benefits include its potential to lower blood pressure, improve respiratory health, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Coelogyne stricta are attributed to its ability to relax muscles, reduce anxiety, and promote better sleep. The bioactive constituents of Coelogyne stricta include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
